traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements for 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG are satisfied.
- Core Functionality: The plugin exposes recommended and strict presets (configs.recommended and configs.strict) implemented as ESLint v9 flat-config objects, with tests verifying their structure and severity mappings. - Quality Standards / Flat Config: The project uses ESLint v9 flat config itself and integrates the plugin through that mechanism. The presets are designed for flat-config usage and are documented with flat-config examples. - Integration: An integration test invokes the real ESLint CLI with the project’s eslint.config.js and plugin, confirming that configuration works with ESLint and that rules behave correctly under that config. - User Experience: Dedicated user docs (ESLint 9 setup guide, API reference, examples) provide clear setup instructions, multiple project-type configurations (JS, TS, mixed, monorepo), and troubleshooting guidance. - Error Handling: Rule metadata includes JSON Schema definitions with additionalProperties: false and constrained enums, so invalid configuration options are reported cleanly by ESLint. The eslint.config.js handling of plugin loading also distinguishes CI vs local development and fails with a clear message in CI when the plugin is missing. - Documentation: Configuration presets, rule options, and migration guidance are thoroughly documented across user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md, user-docs/api-reference.md, user-docs/examples.md, and user-docs/migration-guide.md.
Given the implemented code, targeted tests referencing this story, successful test execution for those files, and comprehensive user-facing documentation, this story is fully implemented and passes.
